report_comment.text: FUS encodes an RNA-binding protein involved in RNA processing and transcriptional regulation. ERG encodes an ETS-family transcription factor involved in vascular and hematopoietic development. The t(16;21)(p11;q22) rearrangement joins FUS and ERG and defines a rare AML subgroup with a gene-expression profile distinct from RUNX1::CBFA2T3 AML. FUS::ERG also occurs rarely in Ewing sarcoma; the leukemia outcome evidence does not establish sarcoma prognosis. Pediatric FUS::ERG AML has shown poor outcomes and frequent relapse in the international I-BFM cohort.
